appraisal_events.evidence: "presque sans dissimulation... il plongea un regard attentif, sérieux, absorbé, presque soucieux, dans les profondeurs du corsage"; the narrator attributes this to declining 'volonté morale' or 'pouvoir physique' from his advanced illness; Swann himself later jokes to the narrator that he would enjoy the portrait 'sûrement plus de plaisir qu'à Charlus.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator frankly frames Swann's undisguised, absorbed ogling of Mme de Surgis as a lapse of self-command brought on by illness and age, though Swann's own rakish aside recasts the same fixation as a point of comic pride over Charlus.

appraisal_events.evidence: "vous m'excuserez si j'ai paru vous éviter depuis quelque temps"... the Prince nonetheless confides to Swann, and to no one else, his private doubts about 'graves illégalités' in the Dreyfus proceedings; Swann tells the narrator 'vous verrez pourquoi je vous choisis pour confident.'
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite having distanced himself over their opposed Dreyfus views, the Prince singles Swann out to receive a delicate, consequential confidence, marking Swann as uniquely trusted rather than shunned.

appraisal_events.evidence: "elle avait mal calculé en le choisissant comme amant. Car toutes les amies de la duchesse de Guermantes allaient prendre parti pour elle, et ainsi Mme de Surgis redescendrait pour la deuxième fois cette pente qu'elle avait eu tant de peine à remonter."
appraisal_events.explanation: Having only recently clawed her way back into society, Mme de Surgis's affair with the duc de Guermantes is framed as a miscalculation that will turn the duchesse's circle against her and threaten her hard-won standing.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's frank account of Swann's absorbed, undisguised desire, explained by failing moral or physical restraint, diminishes the discretion and dignity he once had.
The Prince, who had been avoiding Swann over political disagreement, crosses back over that line to draw him in as sole confidant of a sensitive private matter.
Her liaison with Basin is narrated as a miscalculated risk that will mobilize the duchesse's allies against her, threatening the social ground she had slowly reclaimed.
